title: S. cerevisiae Δpho84 Complementation: Metal Toxicity
author: David S Milner
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.re4d3gw

steps.title: Grow S. cerevisiae strains
steps.instruction: Grow 10 ml of S. cerevisiae strains BY5676 p416 GPD, BY2959 p416 GPD, and BY2959 pXXX [p416 GPD + gene of interest] in Sc-ura medium.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 16 hours at 30°C with 200 rpm shaking.
Grow each strain in triplicate using 3 independently obtained transformants.

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells at 1,810 x g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare cell dilutions
steps.instruction: Dilute cells to an OD 600 of 1.0 and prepare a dilution series down to 10^-4.

steps.title: Spot cells onto metal plates
steps.instruction: Spot 10 µl of each dilution onto Sc-ura plates containing the metals to be assayed.

substeps.instruction: Include a Sc-ura plate with no added metal as a positive control.

Test the following suggested starting concentrations (or concentrations on either side): Potassium chromate (300 µM), Cobalt chloride (1 mM), Zinc chloride (10 mM), Sodium arsenate (3 mM), Manganese chloride (10 mM), and Copper chloride (1 mM).
Image plates on a G:BOX imaging system (Syngene) to identify compounds where toxicity was restored by the addition of pXXX.
Use results to optimize compound concentrations for a second run.
